end.summary:
Practised examples of diversity in language, food, dress and festivals across India.
Explained unity in diversity using friendships, shared celebrations and learning from different traditions.
Identified shared threads through seasonal festivals, common values and different local customs.
Connected festival examples including Pongal, Bihu, Lohri, Makar Sankranti, Diwali and Chhath Puja.
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different languages, foods, clothes and festival customs can exist within one society. They used examples clearly, including friendship across languages and shared values such as celebrating together and learning from one another. They briefly mixed up the idea of a shared thread with everyone doing the same thing, but later corrected this by explaining that festivals can have different customs while sharing a season, purpose or value. At home, ask them to choose one festival and name two different regional forms plus one shared thread.
